## 1.0.0 (2026-09-02)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Correct README punctuation and formatting ([3e21a3c](https://github.com/adderalladmiral/test-actual/commit/3e21a3c9132e7fd8842db60cd4461e49cc943ee5))
* Merge pull request [#10](https://github.com/adderalladmiral/test-actual/issues/10) from adderalladmiral/dev ([f5d49d2](https://github.com/adderalladmiral/test-actual/commit/f5d49d2c8062b3a5eec83239dda4042a5cb108de))

patches.name: Clone
patches.description: Renames the package and app label so the patched build installs alongside a stock Journal instead of replacing it.

options.description: A new package name for the patched app.
A new app name (label). Entering "Journal" skips changing the label.

patches.name: Custom substances database
patches.description: Replaces the bundled Substances.json asset with your own file.

options.description: Absolute path on your machine to the replacement Substances.json file.

patches.name: Hide bottom tabs
patches.description: Lets you individually hide the Stats, Drugs and Safer tabs from the bottom navigation bar. Journal and Settings can't be hidden.

options.description: Removes the Stats tab from the bottom navigation bar.
Removes the Drugs tab from the bottom navigation bar.
Removes the Safer tab from the bottom navigation bar.

patches.name: Hide feedback section
patches.description: Removes the "Feedback" section (FAQ, bug report, copy support info) from Settings.

patches.name: Purge RevenueCat
patches.description: Stops the app from ever talking to RevenueCat's servers: skips SDK initialization on startup and neuters the app's periodic "refresh entitlement" network calls. Requires Unlock premium to also be enabled - without it, premium status has no way to ever resolve as active.

patches.name: Remove internet permission
patches.description: Removes the ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permission, and optionally INTERNET too.

options.description: Also removes the INTERNET permission. Requires "Purge RevenueCat" to also be enabled - without it, RevenueCat's SDK crashes on startup when it can't find INTERNET declared in the manifest.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Forces the RevenueCat "premium" entitlement check to always resolve as active, including before the app has ever reached RevenueCat's servers.
